versions.changelog: Document Uber Eats item-detail endpoint sensitivity: on LFD_BLOCKED, agents should stop using the item command for a while; search/restaurant/menu keep working.
Uber Eats item lookups now carry location context (store coordinates) like the web client does, avoiding intermittent WAF rejections on getMenuItemV1.
Fix truncated JSON for outputs over 64KiB when piped (process.exitCode instead of process.exit). Large menus now arrive complete in agent pipelines.
Fix intermittent empty Uber Eats menus: catalogSectionsMap entries vary in order and can be empty; now picks the richest entry.

Add Uber Eats Germany as second read-only provider (--provider ubereats): feed search, store details, menus, item option groups, availability, local cart simulation. Cross-process request pacing. Same safety model: no ordering, no payment, no auth, no bot-protection bypass.

Initial release: read-only Lieferando (Germany) discovery via public JET endpoints. Search, restaurant, menu, item option groups, availability, local-only cart simulation. No ordering, no payment, no auth.
